sn41.3:1.1: Ekaṃ samayam sambahulā therā bhikkhū Macchikāsaṇḍe viharanti Ambāṭakavane || || 2
sn41.3:1.2: Atha kho Citto gahapati yena therā bhikkhū tenupasaṅkami || upasaṅkamitvā there bhikkhū abhivādetvā ekam antaṃ nisīdi || || 3 Ekam antaṃ nisinno kho Citti gahapati there bhikkhū etad avoca || ||
sn41.3:1.3: Adhivāsentu me bhante therā svātanāya bhattanti || ||
sn41.3:1.5: Atha kho Citto gahapati therānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ adhivāsanaṃ viditvā uṭṭhāyāsanā there bhikkhū abhivādetvā padakkhiṇaṃ katvā pakkāmi || || 5
sn41.3:1.6: Atha kho therā bhikkhū tassā rattiyā accayena pubbanhasamayaṃ nivāsetvā pattacīvaram ādāya yena Cittassa gahapatino nivesanaṃ tenupasaṅkamiṃsu || upasaṅkamitvā paññatte āsane nisīdiṃsu || || 6
sn41.3:2.1: Atha kho Citto gahapati yena therā bhikkhū tenupasaṅkami || upasaṅkamitvā there bhikkhū abhivādetvā ekam antaṃ nisīdi || || 7 Ekam antaṃ nisinno kho Citto gahapati āyasmantaṃ Theram etad avoca || ||
sn41.3:2.2: Yā imā bhante Thera anekavihitā diṭṭhiyo loke uppajjanti ||
sn41.3:2.3: Sassato loko ti vā || Asassato lokoti vā || Antavā lokoti vā Anantavā lokoti vā || Tam jīvaṃ taṃ sarīran ti vā Aññam jīvaṃ aññaṃ sarīranti vā || Hoti tathāgato param maraṇā ti vā Na hoti tathāgato param maraṇā ti vā || Hoti ca na ca hoti tathāgato param maraṇā ti vā || Neva hoti na na hoti tathāgato param maraṇā ti vā ||
sn41.3:2.5: imā nu kho bhante diṭṭhiyo kismiṃ sati honti kismiṃ asati na hontīti || ||
sn41.3:3.1: Evam vutte āyasmā Thero tuṇhi ahosi || || 8
sn41.3:3.2: Dutiyam pi kho Citto gahapati || pe || || 9
sn41.3:3.3: Tatiyam pi kho Citto gahapati āyasmantaṃ Theram avoca ||
sn41.3:3.4: Yā imā bhante Thera anekavihitā diṭṭhiyo loke uppajjanti ||
sn41.3:3.5: Sassato loko ti vā Asassato lokoti vā || Antavā loko ti vā Anantāvā loko ti vā || Taṃ jīvaṃ taṃ sarīranti vā Aññaṃ jīvaṃ aññaṃ sarīranti vā || Hoti tathāgato param maraṇā ti vā Na hoti tathagato param maraṇā ti vā Hoti ca na ca hoti tathāgato param maraṇā ti vā Neva hoti na na hoti tathāgato param maraṇā ti vā ||
sn41.3:3.6: Yāni cimāni dvāsaṭṭhi diṭṭhigatāni Brahmajāle bhaṇitāni ||
sn41.3:3.7: imā nu kho bhante diṭṭhiyo kismiṃ sati honti kismiṃ asati na hontī ti || ||
sn41.3:3.8: Tatiyam pi kho āyasmā Thero tuṇhi ahosi || || 10
sn41.3:4.1: Tena kho pana samayena āyasmā Isidatto tasmiṃ bhikkhusaṅghe sabbanavako hoti || || 11
sn41.3:4.2: Atha kho āyasmā Isidatto āyasmantaṃ Theram etad avoca ||
sn41.3:4.3: Vyākaromaham bhante Thera Cittassa gahapatino etam pañhanti || ||
sn41.3:4.4: Vyākarohi tvam āvuso Isidatta Cittassa gahapatino etam pañhanti || || 12
sn41.3:4.6: Yā imā bhante Thera anekavihitā diṭṭhiyo loke uppajjanti ||
sn41.3:4.8: imā nu kho bhante diṭṭhiyo kismiṃ sati honti kismiṃ asati na hontī ti || ||
sn41.3:4.10: Yā imā gahapati anekavihitā diṭṭhiyo loke uppajjanti ||
sn41.3:4.11: Sassato lokoti vā Asassato loko ti vā || Antavā loko ti vā Anantavā lokoti vā || Taṃ jīvaṃ taṃ sarīranti vā || Aññaṃ jīvam aññaṃ sarīranti vā || Hoti tathāgato param maraṇā ti vā Na hoti tathāgato param maraṇā ti vā Hoti ca na ca hoti tathāgato param maraṇā ti vā Neva hoti na na hoti tathāgato param maraṇā ti vā ||
sn41.3:4.13: imā kho gahapati diṭṭhiyo sakkāyadiṭṭhiyā sati honti || sakkāyadiṭṭhiyā asati na hontī ti || || 13
sn41.3:5.1: Katham pana bhante sakkāyadiṭṭhi hotī ti || ||
sn41.3:5.2: Idha gahapati assutavā puthujjano ariyānam adassāvī ariyadhammassa akovido ariyadhamme avinīto sappurisānam adassāvī sapurisadhammassa akovido sappurisadhamme avinīto
sn41.3:5.3: rūpam attato samanupassati rūpavantaṃ vā attānam attani vā rūpam rūpasmiṃ vā attānaṃ ||
sn41.3:5.7: Viññāṇam attato samanupassati viññāṇavantaṃ vā attānam attani vā viññāṇaṃ viññāṇasmiṃ vā attānaṃ || ||
sn41.3:5.8: Evaṃ kho gahapati sakkāyadiṭṭhi hotī ti || || 14
sn41.3:6.1: Katham pana bhante sakkāyadiṭṭhi na hotī ti || ||
sn41.3:6.2: Idha gahapati sutavā ariyasāvako ariyānaṃ dassāvī ariyadhammassa kovido ariyadhamme suvinīto sappurisānam dassāvī sappurisadhammassa kovido sappurisadhamme suvinīto
sn41.3:6.3: na rūpam attato samanupassati na rūpavantaṃ vā attānaṃ na attani vā rūpaṃ na rūpasmim vā attānaṃ ||
sn41.3:6.7: Na viññāṇam attato samanupassati na viññāṇavantam vā attānam na attani vā viññāṇaṃ na viññāṇasmiṃ vā attānaṃ || ||
sn41.3:6.8: Evaṃ kho gahapati sakkāyadiṭṭhi na hotī ti || || 15
sn41.3:7.1: Kuto bhante ayyo Isidatto āgacchatī ti || ||
sn41.3:7.3: Atthi bhante Avantiyā Isidatto nāma kulaputto amhākam adiṭṭhasahāyo pabbajjito ||
sn41.3:7.6: Kahaṃ nu kho bhante āyasmā etarahi viharatī ti || ||
sn41.3:7.7: Evaṃ vutte āyasmā Isidatto tuṇhi ahosi ||
sn41.3:8.1: Atha kho Citto gahapati āyasmato Isidattassa bhāsitam abhinanditvā anumoditvā there bhikkhū paṇītena khādaniyena bhojaniyena sahatthā santappesi sampavāresi || || 17
sn41.3:8.2: Atha kho therā bhikkhū bhuttāvino onītapattapāṇino uṭṭhāyāsanā pakkamiṃsu || || 18
sn41.3:8.3: Atha kho āyasmā Thero āyasmantam Isidattam etad avoca || ||
sn41.3:8.4: Sādhu kho tam āvuso Isidatta eso pañho paṭibhāsi
sn41.3:8.6: tena hāvuso Isidatta yadā aññadā pi evarūpo pañho āgaccheyya taññevettha patibhāseyyāti || || 19
sn41.3:8.7: Atha kho āyasmā Isidatto senāsanaṃ saṃsāmetvā pattacīvaram ādāya Macchikāsaṇḍamhā pakkāmi ||
sn41.3:8.8: Yaṃ Macchikāsaṇḍamhā pakkāmi tathā pakkanto va ahosi na puna pacchāgacchīti || || 1
